answer.text: Earning exempt income (e.g., tax-free dividends historically)

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 14A: expenses attributable to exempt income are disallowed for tax computation. The Trap: Nuanced; relates to proportionate disallowance for exempt income. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B tax. Manager's Pro-Tip: Post-dividend tax reform, Section 14A less applied to dividends; still applies to exempt incomes.
